description: This file contains functions and classes related to scheduling grant parameters for uplink and downlink in a 5G NR context, including calculation of MCS, PRBs, VRBs, and scheduling contexts for both new transmissions and retransmissions.

classes.name: mcs_prbs_selection
classes.description: Struct representing recommended MCS and PRBs for scheduling.

methods.name: compute_newtx_required_mcs_and_prbs
methods.description: Calculates the required MCS and PRBs for a new transmission based on pending bytes and channel conditions.

methods.name: compute_pusch_config_params
methods.description: Determines PUSCH configuration parameters based on DCI type and UE state.

methods.name: compute_newtx_pusch_config_params
methods.description: Derives PUSCH config parameters for a new transmission.

methods.name: compute_retx_pusch_config_params
methods.description: Derives PUSCH config parameters for a retransmission.

methods.name: compute_newtx_required_mcs_and_prbs
methods.description: Calculates MCS and PRBs for a new PUSCH grant based on pending bytes.

methods.name: get_dl_sched_context
methods.description: Generates downlink scheduling context for a given UE and slot configuration.

methods.name: get_newtx_dl_sched_context
methods.description: Wrapper to get downlink scheduling context for new transmission.

methods.name: get_retx_dl_sched_context
methods.description: Wrapper to get downlink scheduling context for retransmission.

methods.name: find_available_vrbs
methods.description: Finds available VRB interval for scheduling.

methods.name: compute_newtx_dl_vrbs
methods.description: Computes VRBs for a new downlink transmission.

methods.name: compute_retx_dl_vrbs
methods.description: Computes VRBs for a downlink retransmission.

methods.name: get_ul_sched_context
methods.description: Generates uplink scheduling context for a UE and slot configuration.

methods.name: get_newtx_ul_sched_context
methods.description: Wrapper to get uplink scheduling context for new transmission.

methods.name: get_retx_ul_sched_context
methods.description: Wrapper to get uplink scheduling context for retransmission.

methods.name: find_available_vrbs
methods.description: Finds available VRB interval for uplink scheduling.

methods.name: compute_newtx_ul_vrbs
methods.description: Computes VRBs for a new uplink transmission.

methods.name: compute_retx_ul_vrbs
methods.description: Computes VRBs for an uplink retransmission.
